seo.meta_description: OpenLoop provides white-label telehealth infrastructure for digital health companies. 16,000+ clinicians, 400+ brands. Launch virtual care in days.

faqs.a: Telehealth infrastructure platform that powers other companies' virtual care services. They provide the clinician network (16,000+), technology platform, licensing/credentialing, and operational support—all white-labeled under the client's brand. 400+ virtual care brands use OpenLoop.

No. OpenLoop is B2B infrastructure for digital health companies, employers, and health tech startups who want to launch telehealth under their own brand. If you're an individual practitioner, look at Doxy.me, SimplePractice, or Medici instead.

Complete virtual care operations: clinician staffing across all 50 states, NCQA-certified licensing and credentialing, white-label technology platform (API-driven), revenue cycle management, pharmacy services, diagnostics, and regulatory compliance.

faqs.q: How quickly can you launch with OpenLoop?
faqs.a: Days, not months. They built a 'virtual care operating system' that handles all the infrastructure complexity. You bring the patient experience and brand; they provide everything else.

faqs.q: Does OpenLoop include mental health clinicians?
faqs.a: Yes. Their 16,000+ clinician network includes mental health providers. Digital health companies building teletherapy or telepsychiatry services can staff through OpenLoop rather than recruiting their own provider panel.

faqs.q: How does OpenLoop compare to Wheel or Cadence?
faqs.a: All three are telehealth infrastructure companies. OpenLoop emphasizes speed-to-launch and comprehensive services (including pharmacy/diagnostics). Wheel focuses on clinician flexibility. The right choice depends on your specific needs for clinician types, geography, and service complexity.

one_liner: White-label telehealth infrastructure for digital health companies. Powers 400+ virtual care brands
